title: Grid Archive Search
description: You are managing a digital archive organized as a 2D matrix of records. Each row is sorted in non-decreasing order from left to right, and the first integer of each row is greater than the last integer of the previous row. Given a target archive ID, determine if it is present in the 2D matrix.
input_format: A 2D integer array matrix and an integer target.
output_format: A boolean value indicating whether the target exists in the matrix.

examples.explanation: 3 is located in the first row.
13 is not present in the matrix.
Single element matrix containing the target.
